$comment: ElevenLabs Agents > Analysis > Data collection. 25 items (non-enterprise plan limit is 25; checked Oct 24, 2026). Types allowed: string, boolean, integer, number. Each 'description' is the extraction prompt pasted into ElevenLabs. 'pdf' lists CF 285 field numbers; the real field name is 'CF 285  <n>' with TWO spaces. 'server' notes what the webhook does with it. Never add an SSN field.
form: CF 285 (8/21) Application for CalFresh Benefits, forms/CF285_unlocked.pdf

items.description: Caller's full legal name as First Middle Last, exactly as they said or spelled it. Use the spelled version if they spelled it. Null if not given.
Caller's date of birth as MM/DD/YYYY. Null if they skipped it.
California county where the caller lives or stays now, for example 'Sacramento'. County name only, no word 'County'.
items.server: Routes the application. Shown on summary page with that county's CalFresh contact. Not a PDF field.

items.description: Where the caller sleeps now. One of: own_place, with_family_or_friends, transitional_or_sober_living, shelter, outside_or_vehicle, other.
pdf: 20 homeless Yes if shelter or outside_or_vehicle
items.server: with_family_or_friends and other: leave 20/21 blank, helper asks.

items.description: Street address where the caller stays, as 'street | city | ZIP'. If no fixed address, write 'No fixed address' plus the city and a short place description they gave, for example 'No fixed address | Oakland | near 14th and Broadway'.
Where the caller can get mail, as 'street | city | ZIP', if different from home_address. Write 'same' if the same. Write 'needs help' if they have nowhere to get mail.
Best phone number for the county to reach the caller, 10 digits. If they said 'this number', copy {{system__caller_id}}. Null if they have no phone.
True only if the caller clearly said yes to getting texts at phone_number. False if no or not asked.
items.server: Gate for ALL SMS. False means no text is sent.

items.description: Language the caller prefers to read and speak if not English, for example 'Spanish'. Null if English.

JSON array of OTHER people the caller lives with. Each item: {"name": string, "relationship": string, "dob": "MM/DD/YYYY" or null, "buys_and_cooks_together": true/false, "applying": true/false/null, "us_citizen": "yes"/"no"/"skip"}. Use [] if the caller lives alone or only with people they do not share food with and did not name. Do not include the caller.
Total money from work (before taxes) the caller's food household got or expects THIS calendar month, in dollars. 0 if none. Null if unknown.
Who works, employer name, hourly pay, hours per week, how often paid, and whether it will continue. Short plain text. Null if no work income.

Total money NOT from work the food household got or expects THIS month: family help, gifts, Social Security, SSI, unemployment, General Assistance, etc. Do not count cash already counted in cash_and_bank. 0 if none.
For non-work money: who gets it, from where (for example 'my aunt', 'SSI', 'General Assistance'), how often, and if it will continue. Null if none.
Total cash on hand plus money in any bank account or debit card for the food household right now, in dollars, including any release money still left. 0 if none.
What the household pays per month for rent, mortgage, or shelter or program fees. 0 if they pay nothing.
pdf: 418 shelter cost Yes if in shelter

items.description: Comma-separated list of bills the household pays separately from rent: heating_cooling, phone, water_trash. Write 'none' if none. Leave null if not asked.
items.server: Since Nov 1, 2025 heating/cooling must be separate from rent for the utility allowance unless someone is 60+ or disabled (CDSS H.R. 1 FAQ).

items.description: Caller's own answer to 'Are you a U.S. citizen?'. One of: yes, no, skip. Never record immigration status details or document numbers.
items.server: 'no' sets the immigration_check flag: summary says a helper and the county will go over it. Q6b/Q6c stay blank.

items.description: Date the caller came home from prison or jail, MM/DD/YYYY. If only approximate, write what they said, like 'about 2 weeks ago'. Null if not asked or skipped.
items.server: Not on CF 285. Used for flags (Medi-Cal exit papers, parole reporting) and the helper summary.

items.description: Does the caller have a California ID card or driver license now? One of: yes, no, unsure.
items.server: 'no' turns on the reduced-fee ID flag.

items.description: Does the caller already have Medi-Cal or Medi-Cal papers from release? One of: yes, no, unsure.
items.server: 'unsure' or 'no' turns on 'check your exit papers' flag.

items.description: Does the caller have their Social Security card in hand? One of: yes, no, unsure. Do NOT record the number.
items.server: Shown as a to-do item only. The number is never asked.

items.description: True if the caller said yes to 'Do you want the county to check Medi-Cal too?'. False if no. Null if not asked.
True only if the caller said yes to a Boundless Freedom Project helper seeing their answers and calling them back.
items.server: Gate for helper notification. False means only the caller gets the link.

items.description: One of: confirmed (caller heard the read-back and said it was right, with fixes made), cleared (caller asked to clear or delete answers), incomplete (call ended before read-back was confirmed), handoff (caller asked for a person and was transferred or given the number), crisis (caller mentioned wanting to hurt themselves or others, or immediate danger).
items.server: cleared: store nothing, send nothing. crisis: store nothing unless also confirmed; no automated text about crisis. incomplete: store, text says 'partly done'. confirmed/handoff: store and text.

computed_server_side.expedited_a: earned_income_month + other_income_month < 150 AND cash_and_bank <= 100 -> 554 Yes else 553 No (null inputs -> leave blank)
computed_server_side.expedited_b: earned_income_month + other_income_month + cash_and_bank < housing_cost_month + utility_estimate -> 556 Yes. utility_estimate: use 0 unless utilities includes heating_cooling (then mark 'maybe' and let county apply its allowance). If result only flips with utilities, leave 555/556 blank and show 'county checks'.
computed_server_side.q11_any_expense: 393 Yes if housing_cost_month > 0 or utilities not 'none'/null, else 393b No

never_collect: SSN or any part of it
answers to CF 285 Q17 to Q22 (applicant answers when signing)
